answer: Stop sybils with a pigment reef comet: an agent bonds one reef shelf. Each cycle it fires one pigment tile; when the comet crosses, verifiers match the tile's glow to the reef chart, voiding a copied or twice-claimed tile, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 reefs at 17x: one tile fires once for one reef, hue set by the coral, unreusable at a second crossing, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents fire once, keep rights.
